Avoid! Expensive, avg food, dirty, mosquitoes, poor service
Aug 2019 • Family
This place is clearly meant for Chinese tour groups. Avoid at all costs!
Food is 2x-3x overpriced compared to similar quality restaurants. $50 for 3 ppl. Nothing tasted particularly good. Waiter tried to push us repeatedly to order their Chinese style dishes (probably pre-made and leftover from one of the Chinese tour group lunch orders). The Vietnamese dishes we ordered were nothing special. 

Make sure you bring mosquito spray if you’re going to stay for more than a few minutes. 

Also be careful of the bathrooms. My wife got stuck in the bathroom because the door was rusted and off track. When she yelled for help, the staff scolded her for closing the door, saying “of course it doesn’t work. Who needs to close the bathroom stall door anyway?” 

The waiter refused to take a picture for the table too, saying it wasn’t her job. 

Go for a coffee and a quick photo shoot with the old wooden houses and rock carvings. Otherwise, avoid this place!
